predictions.text: A little biased? Duncan is arguably the greatest PF, but he didn't do enough to be in the GOAT discussion. Kobe's in the same boat. He's 2nd greatest SG of all, and came up short. Both have 5. Both were considered the best, and one of the best players in the league at their peaks.
